description: PostgreSQL monitoring for Rekon and dossier. Based on prometheus-community/postgres_exporter v0.19.1's Postgres Overview mixin, adapted to PostgreSQL 18.

panels.title: Transactions / second
panels.description: Committed plus rolled-back transactions per second, not SQL statement count.

panels.title: Buffer activity
panels.description: PostgreSQL 18 moved checkpoint buffers to pg_stat_checkpointer and removed backend buffer/fsync fields from pg_stat_bgwriter.

targets.expr: round(sum by (namespace, instance, datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace=~"$namespace",datname=~"$db",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (namespace, instance, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace=~"$namespace",datname=~"$db",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (namespace, instance, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace=~"$namespace",datname=~"$db",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))*100,0.001)

panels.title: Connections (all states)
